entities.summary: Gertrude Fanny Neumark, also known as Gertrude Neumark Rothschild, was an American physicist, most noted for her work in material science and physics of semiconductors with emphasis on optical and electrical properties of wide-bandgap semiconductors and their light-emitting devices.
